# travelprep-mcp -- full reference

Trip preparation MCP server. FastMCP 3.4+, Python 3.12+, dual transport
(stdio default; HTTP `/mcp` on port 11099 via `MCP_TRANSPORT=http`).

REST endpoints (HTTP mode only):
    GET /api/capabilities  -- capability introspection (WEBAPP_STANDARDS.md S1.4)
    GET /api/health        -- liveness
    GET /api/tools         -- dynamic tool list

## Tool: stays

Portmanteau for Airbnb and Booking.com search + details.

```
stays(
    operation: "search" | "details",
    provider: "airbnb" | "booking",
    location: str | None = None,       # required for operation="search"
    listing_id: str | None = None,     # required for operation="details"
                                        # (airbnb: numeric id; booking: full hotel URL)
    checkin: str | None = None,        # YYYY-MM-DD; required for provider="booking"
    checkout: str | None = None,       # YYYY-MM-DD; required for provider="booking"
    adults: int = 1,
    children: int = 0,
    min_price: int | None = None,      # airbnb only
    max_price: int | None = None,      # airbnb only
) -> dict
```

Backed by:
- `openbnb-org/mcp-server-airbnb` (MIT) via `npx -y @openbnb/mcp-server-airbnb --ignore-robots-txt`, subprocess stdio
- `insprd/hotelzero` (MIT) via `npx -y hotelzero`, subprocess stdio, Playwright-driven

Known issues (confirmed live, not theoretical):
- Airbnb location matching is loose (Photon -> Nominatim fallback, 25% bbox padding)
- Booking.com bot-detects the scraper; expect occasional blocked-then-retried searches

## Tool: hotel_extras

Booking.com-only extras beyond basic search/details.

```
hotel_extras(
    operation: "find_hotels" | "compare" | "check_availability" | "reviews" | "price_calendar",
    location: str | None = None,
    hotel_url: str | None = None,
    hotel_urls: list[str] | None = None,
    checkin: str | None = None,
    checkout: str | None = None,
    adults: int = 2,
    rooms: int = 1,
    filters: dict | None = None,
    sort_by: str = "recent",
    filter_by: str | None = None,
    price_calendar_start: str | None = None,
    price_calendar_nights: int = 14,
) -> dict
```

All operations delegate to the same hotelzero subprocess as `stays(provider="booking")`.
Wired from a confirmed `list_tools()` schema; not individually live-exercised.

Echoes budget caps (300 EUR/night, 1500 EUR/trip) per result. No automatic flagging
against those caps until upstream result shape is confirmed with a live call.

## Tool: destination

Free-source destination info. No API keys required.

```
destination(
    operation: "overview" | "weather" | "practical" | "full",
    place: str,
    forecast_days: int = 7,            # weather/full only, 1-16
) -> dict
```

All free, keyless sources:
- Wikipedia REST summary API (overview)
- Wikivoyage REST summary API (practical)
- Open-Meteo geocoding + forecast (weather; also used to resolve country for practical)
- REST Countries (currency, languages, calling code, capital, timezones)

Returns `available: false` with a `reason` string per section on a miss,
never fabricated data.

## Tool: account

Booking.com account access via a locally-persisted, isolated login session.

```
account(
    operation: "login" | "status" | "trips" | "wishlist" | "rewards"
) -> dict
```

Operations:
- login: opens a headed browser window for interactive Booking.com login; session persists locally
- status: checks whether a local session profile exists (does not confirm validity)
- trips: past and upcoming bookings (parsing is an unverified first pass)
- wishlist: saved properties (parsing is an unverified first pass)
- rewards: Genius level / wallet / rewards balance (parsing is an unverified first pass)

Uses an isolated Playwright profile under `~/.travelprep-mcp/booking-profile/`, not
Sandra's default browser session. No booking-execution capability exists anywhere
in this server -- see budget.py.

## Budget

Hardcoded spend caps: MAX_NIGHTLY_RATE_EUR = 300, MAX_TOTAL_TRIP_EUR = 1500.
No booking-execution tool exists -- the server can search, inspect, and compare,
but never purchase. This is a deliberate design choice documented in budget.py.

## Not yet implemented

- Webapp (scaffold exists: Vite+React+Tailwind, zero pages)
- Prefab UI in-chat cards for list/status results
- MCPB packaging
- Tauri/NSIS desktop wrapper
